name: scrutiny-collector
description: Scrutiny S.M.A.R.T Metrics Collector (Hub/Spoke mode). Collects S.M.A.R.T data from drives and sends it to the Scrutiny web server. Requires a running Scrutiny web server instance. Use the omnibus template instead if you want an all-in-one deployment. You must add each drive as a Device in the container settings. Alternatively, toggle Privileged mode to ON in the Unraid Docker UI to grant access to all drives automatically (less secure).

paths.name: Udev
paths.description: Required for device detection. Do not change.

variables.name: API Endpoint
variables.description: Scrutiny web server URL (e.g. http://scrutiny-web:8080). Required.

variables.name: Host ID
variables.description: Unique identifier for this collector host. Useful when running multiple collectors.

variables.name: Cron Schedule
variables.description: S.M.A.R.T data collection schedule (cron format). Default: daily at midnight.

variables.name: Run on Startup
variables.description: Run S.M.A.R.T data collection immediately on container startup.

devices.name: Disk 1
devices.description: First disk to monitor. Add more Device entries for additional disks. For NVMe, pass both /dev/nvme0 (controller) and /dev/nvme0n1 (namespace).
